summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K) covering September 2026, furnishing a press release announcing AIIC 2.0, an upgrade to its Singapore AI Innovation Centre adding Model as a Service capabilities hosted with STTGDC at the STT Singapore 5 facility. The release describes API access to pre-deployed open-weight models, local data residency, and usage controls. No securities, ownership, pricing, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction terms are stated. This is an ordinary product-launch disclosure, not a special situation.
